A '''lightsaber''' was constructed and wielded by [[Chalactan/Legends|Chalactan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] by the time of her ascension to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="PotJ" /> The single-bladed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] had a cylindrical [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]], a flared [[Blade emitter/Legends|blade emitter]], and a single blade, alternatively of red<ref name="SW17" /> or green hue.<ref name="Shatter" />

During the [[Yinchorri Uprising]], Billaba used a red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] against [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] [[Raid on the Jedi Temple (Yinchorri Uprising)|raiders]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="JC2">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 2|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 2]]</ref> in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], and, later,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> on the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Mace Windu)|battle]] with [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Vrblther/Legends|vrblthers]],<ref name="SW17" /> and the [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]] of [[Gargonn]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Circus Horrificus/Legends|Circus Horrificus]].<ref name="SW18" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Depa Billaba's lightsaber first appeared in the [[Jedi Council: Acts of War 2|seventeenth issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Republic|''Star Wars'']] series, written by [[Timothy Truman]] and illustrated by [[John Nadeau]].<ref name="SW17" />
